about_the_game:
The case isn’t over just yet… Dive deeper into the enigma surrounding The Knights’ Oath in this gripping DLC for Detective Club: Gallery of Shadows! With four brand-new locations to explore, you'll uncover more hidden objects, face intricate mini-games, and unravel deeper layers of the story. Discover clues about the legendary Knights of the Round Table, investigate mysterious paintings, and trace the shadowy trail left behind by Armano Vecchio.

Packed with new secrets and challenging puzzles, this bonus chapter is a must-play for every young detective hungry for answers!

🕵🏻‍♂️ Museum Exhibition

Learn more about the real knights depicted in Vecchio’s painting. Solve museum puzzles and decode exhibits to uncover their hidden past!

🕵🏻‍♂️ Finch’s Hidden Gallery

Explore Mr. Finch’s private art storage. Investigate dusty frames, sketchbooks, and Cecil’s quiet corner for clues long forgotten.

🕵🏻‍♂️ The Abandoned Room

Hidden inside an ancient chapel, this crumbling room may be tied to Vecchio himself. Follow the trail he left in his mysterious riddle!

🕵🏻‍♂️ The Secret Room

You’ve found a hidden door — but what’s behind it? Search for pages of George’s father’s lost diary and the truths someone tried to bury!

Whether you're chasing legends, decoding clues, or piecing together a buried family history, this bonus chapter offers hours of extra gameplay, rich atmosphere, and new twists that will keep you hooked until the very last object is found. The truth is closer than ever — if you dare to uncover it!
